snippet.title: SPOOKY TALES ► Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
CHECK IT OUT ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4228190/Spooky_Tales/?utm_source=ShowcaseFall26

GREETINGS, FRIGHT FANS! Spooky Tales is a narrative game with interactive mini-games and a retro-inspired atmosphere. This horror anthology packs four unique stories into one experience: 1920s pulp dread, Japanese body horror, found footage, and classic slashers.

*Four Tales of Terror*
Guided by a charismatic undead host with a morbid sense of humor, Spooky Tales is a horror anthology featuring four unique nightmares in one package.

*Distinct Styles*
A chilling blend of 1920s pulp dread, Japanese body horror, found footage, and 80s VHS charm, all realised through lovingly-hand crafted gritty PSX-style visuals, and weird fiction environments.

*STORIES*
- The Abyss-Borne
Cast your line into the dark waters of a strange coastal village. Armed with a harpoon, hunt the deep ocean—but remember that something ancient is staring back.

- Rineko
A beautiful new student joins the occult club, triggering a wave of unsettling events. As strange events plague the members, you will uncover the terrifying secret behind her perfect facade.

- Golly Soda Pop
A desperate ghost-hunting TV crew breaks into an abandoned soda factory chasing ratings. Keep your cameras rolling as you uncover a nightmare far more real than any fake broadcast.

- Pepperoni Johnson
A rowdy teenage pizza party turns into a nightmare when a fun night in devolves into a gruesome home invasion. Trapped by a merciless killer, a group of unsuspecting friends must fight for their lives, quickly discovering that the only thing getting sliced tonight isn't the pizza.
